verdict.rationale: Orb documents invoice generation with automatic issuance after grace periods, or a manual-approval draft mode (orb-docs-21, orb-docs-34). It also recalculates affected invoices when late data arrives (orb-docs-2) and applies minimums and maximums in invoice calculations (orb-docs-20). Day-based proration credits (orb-docs-16) suggest credit handling, but the pack never mentions credit notes or receipts as documents. Missing for 10: credit note documents, receipts, sequential invoice numbering, custom fields, memos, compliance claims, evidence of automatic delivery to customers (e.g., email), and independent corroboration.
